title: RAW selection geometry permits inclusive reads outside the frame
summary: indigo_raw_utils.c:438-449 and 667-675: selection guards accept xx == width-radius or yy == height-radius, but inclusive loops reach index width/height. PSF accesses all formats directly; selection digest RGB/RGBA variants do too. Public APIs and imager star selection can reach frame-edge selections. Radius zero also allocates zero border storage in PSF before writing one border value. PSF lines 509-515 use int squared-deviation sum, which overflows for ordinary high-contrast 16-bit borders and corrupts HFD/FWHM thresholds. Next: Require a complete positive-radius inclusive ROI (xx+radius < width, yy+radius < height); use double statistics; return failure before reads. Verify right/bottom boundary and a high-contrast mono16 border. This confirms the prior RAW/PSF boundary candidate, without assuming framework generic-number validation solves geometry.
